notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer support automation). Product team evaluating Redwood Hosted API first; aim to move to Dedicated after POC if latency and cost targets met.
- Primary workload: multi-tool chat agents for support reps (tool-calling to ticket system and KB lookup), live streaming responses to UI, structured output for downstream actions.
Key technical requirements / quotes:
- "Need streaming first-byte <200ms for US region and sustained token latency <=40ms/token for common prompts." (PM)
- 100 concurrent agent sessions target initially; expected steady state ~50 req/s, peaks ~120 req/s.
- Tool calling + deterministic structured outputs required for automated ticket updates and escalation flows.
Security & compliance notes:
- Security review in-flight: asked for SOC2 Type II report, architecture diagram, and security FAQ.
- Must support SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning for 2k+ agents.
- Must provide audit logs with PII redaction; "no raw PII in application logs" is non-negotiable per security lead.
- KMS integration and encryption-at-rest required. Data residency for EU customers is a follow-up ask.
POC specifics:
- 2-week Hosted POC planned (start 2026-02-16): integrate chat widget, enable streaming, exercise tool-calling paths, run load to validate latency SLOs.
- Success criteria: 95% startup streaming latency <250ms, 99th-tail <800ms under 100 concurrent sessions, accurate tool-call routing and safe/non-PII logs.
Commercials:
- Interested in 12-month Dedicated commitment if POC validates latency and unit economics. Asked for draft pricing and commitment tiers.
Quotes / misc:
- "If we can get streaming perf + sensible committed pricing, we'll flip to Dedicated for production." – Head of Product
- Security team flagged retention policy: need configurable retention and an option to purge conversational data on demand.
CRM shorthand / actions:
- Sent SOC2 + security FAQ 2026-02-03 (drive link).
- Maya to follow up pricing by 2026-02-14.
- SE Arjun will run token-latency microbench and share report.
